name: Brahma Finance
rootCause: On 9 November 2022, Brahma Finance suffered an exploit on Ethereum due to inadequate access control in its Zapper contract. An attacker leveraged arbitrary external call capability to drain approximately $89,343 in USDC from user accounts. The Zapper contract permitted arbitrary external calls without proper access control, allowing an attacker to execute unauthorized operations and withdraw funds from users.
